title: Columns of the pairwise independent matrix
statement: Let $\ell,n$ be nonnegative integers with $n\le 2^\ell-1$, and form the matrix whose $j$th column is the vector assigned to $j$ by the enumeration of nonzero vectors in $\mathbb F_2^\ell$. For every $j\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, the $j$th column, viewed as a vector, equals that assigned vector.
